units.source_text: 跑到家後，我請姑媽晾乾我們倆被雨水澆透的上衣，成功地領著竹一來到我二樓的房間。

en.t: After running home, I asked my aunt to dry the jackets that the rain had soaked through, and successfully led Takeichi up to my room on the second floor.

units.source_text: 我的這個親戚家只有三口人：年過五旬的姑媽；

en.t: There were only three people in this relative's household: my aunt, who was past fifty;

units.source_text: 三十左右、戴著眼鏡、體弱多病的高個兒大女兒（她曾結過一次婚，後來又回到孃家。

en.t: the elder daughter, about thirty, tall, wearing glasses and often ill, who had once married and later returned to her parents' home.

units.source_text: 我也學著這家裡的人，管她叫大姐）；

en.t: following the habit of the family, I too called her elder sister;

units.source_text: 以及最近好像才從女校畢業，名叫節子的小女兒，跟她姐姐一點都不像，小個頭兒，圓圓臉。

en.t: and the younger daughter, named Setsuko, who seemed to have only recently graduated from girls' school, and who was nothing like her sister, being short and round-faced.

units.source_text: 三人在樓下開了一家店，貨源不多，只陳列有少量文具和運動用品。

en.t: The three of them ran a shop downstairs, but they had little stock and displayed only a small number of stationery items and sporting goods.

units.source_text: 主要的收入來源，好像是靠過世的主人所留下的五六棟簡陋住房的租金。

en.t: Their main source of income seemed to be the rent from five or six shabby row houses left behind by the deceased master of the house.
